status.label: What does the student status mean?
status.text: Status comes from the days since the last check-in: Active up to 6 days, Slowing 7 to 13, Drifting 14 to 29, and Inactive 30 or more (or never trained).

aderencia.label: What is adherence?
aderencia.text: Adherence is the total check-ins per class in the period. Tap a bar to see unique students, average per class and trend.

trend.label: What is the trend?
trend.text: The arrow compares the class’s average attendance with the average of its last 4 occurrences: ↑ 10% or more above, ↓ 10% or more below, → within range, and — not enough history.

ranking.label: How does the ranking work?
ranking.text: The ranking adds up each student’s points in the season: competition results approved by the academy (podium) and point adjustments. Adults and Kids are ranked separately.

seasons.label: What is a season?
seasons.text: A season is the ranking period, with start and end dates and the points for 1st, 2nd and 3rd place. Each result goes into a season by its competition date.

xp.label: What is XP?
xp.text: XP is your accumulated experience: each approved ranking point is worth 10 XP, and badges give XP too. Unlike points, XP doesn’t reset each season.
